title: Zara the Zebra's Zig Zag Stripes | BuBu TV - English
description:
Zara the zebra thinks her wiggly stripes are not right, but her family shows her they are perfect just the way they are.
This fun song teaches little ones that being different is special and something to be proud of.
Sing along and dance with Zara!

Zara the zebra looks at her stripes
"So wiggly, so wiggly!" she did say
Wiggly, wiggly, not even straight at all
What shall we do, Zara?

Zig zag, zig zag, look at me
Zara's stripes go zig zag, see!
Wiggle wiggle, wiggle wiggle
They are just right, just right for me!

Little sis got a ruler, tap tap
Big brother draws a line, a line, a line
Straight, straight, straight... oh no, oh no, look!
Ha ha ha, what a silly sight!

Zig zag, zig zag, look at me
Zara's stripes go zig zag, see!
Wiggle wiggle, wiggle wiggle
They are just right, just right for me!

Zara laughs and says, "My wiggles are fun!"
Every zebra's special, you see
Hip hop, hip hop, one by one
Stripes are special, just like me!

Zig zag, zig zag, look at me
Zara's stripes go zig zag, see!
Wiggle wiggle, wiggle wiggle
They are just right, just right for me!

Amma calls out, "Paint time, come on, come!"
Brush brush brush on paper white
Zig zag, zig zag, see them shine
We are proud of our stripes, yay!
